ordinaryWrites.retry: Preserve original actor + operation + HTTP method/path + exact body + original key + original If-Match and replay same write via defineWrite/idempotency; current GET/latest version is not proof the old intent was accepted. Reauth/revalidate current access before replay, never mint a new intent to guess outcome.
ordinaryWrites.conflict: Known 409 is not Unknown; keep proposed draft/per-item receipts, load current authority for user review before a genuinely new versioned command. Do not overwrite successful objects or replay them using another object version.

messages.resourceKey: Same conversation + actor + clientMessageId + unchanged body; exact conflict on changed body. Permission withdrawn/403 stops retries; never resend old draft to restore rights.

assistant.recovery: Keep exact original requestId and device session/generation; pollAI is dedicated status recovery, not business command-status endpoint; Unknown retains budget reservation, no automatic duplicate model request.

objectVersions.rule: MealExperience, PublicReference, ReconnectSelection and ProductSurvey each consume own server-projected version (including no-record version 0); not meal version or one shared Save version, not inferred on client. Save receives per-object authority/result; current GET after Unknown does not identify original intent.
